risks.title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA)
risks.score_rationale: The impact of the OBBBA reform on institutions and the company's operations is not yet fully known, but could have a significant adverse effect on business due to changes in student financial aid and loan restrictions.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market where other higher education institutions could offer similar programs.

risks.title: Dependence on Federal Financial Aid
risks.score_rationale: The company's students heavily rely on federal financial aid to fund their education, making them vulnerable to regulatory changes.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to student loans and students' ability to repay their debts.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risks related to the quality of its programs and services and the employability of its graduates.
